Initial release of the mod ## features
Dungeon - **Terminal Solver** - A solver for terminals, - Queue - Supports Zero Ping, but you still need your own proxy - **Puzzles** - Ice Fill - Tic Tac Toe - **Abilities** - Ability keybinds for normal ability, and ult - **Pos Msg** - Positional Messages
Movement - **Ether** - Etherwarp overlay - No Rotate - Fake Zpew, (Does not actually move the player) - **Null Binds/SOCD/Rappy Snappy** - Like wooting keyboard behaviour, if you're holding a and press d, a unpresses until you unpress d
Player - **Key Shortcuts** - Bind commands to keys - **Chest Hit Fix** - Allows you to interact on chests while holding left click
Render - **Hide** - Hide Players (Range, P3, Device) - Hide Mini Wither - Hide dying - **Hud** - Time Hud - **OpSec** - Name Hider - Server ID Hider - **Visual Words** - Replaces text visually - **Image Hud** - Draws images on the screen - **Jesus** - Jesus - **Mana Star** - Shows Terraria inspired Mana stars for your Skyblock mana - **Module List** - Renders a list of enabled modules - **Trail** - Renders a trail behind you
